source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 109(1)(2): contract ends when its term expires; Art. 109(2): termination is formalised by the employer's individual legal act; Art. 111(2): employer gives at least 10 days' written notice before expiry (not for replacement workers or contracts for specific works, 111(3)). Art. 95 contains no notice duty.

title.hy: Որոշակի ժամկետով պայմանագիրը շուտով ավարտվում է

edge_cases: 30-day reminder window is a product choice; the legal deadline is 10 days before the end (Art. 111(2)), used as the due date.
Art. 111(2) notice is not required for replacement workers or contracts for specific works (111(3)): not modelled.
Working past the end date makes the contract indefinite (Art. 111(5)): see fixed-term-expired. Extension or re-hire within a month: see fixed-term-chain.
